newsitem.title: USA: Harnischfeger seeks Giddings shareholder meeting.
newsitem.headline: Harnischfeger seeks Giddings shareholder meeting.

text.p: Harnsichfeger Industries Inc said Thursday it filed a definitive solicitation statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission in its effort to force a meeting of shareholders of its acquisition target, Giddings & Lewis Inc.

The purpose of the meeting is an attempt to remove the Giddings board of directors and to replace them with nominees of Harnischfeger that would then dismantle Giddings takeover defenses, mining, papermaking and material handling equipment maker Harnischfeger said.

Fond du Lac, Wisconsin-based Giddings' board of directors has rejected a $19 a share cash tender offer from Harnischfeger as inadequate and said it has had discussions with other parties about a possible transaction.

Receipt of written demands of holders of record of 10 percent all Giddings shares is needed in order to require the meeting. Harnischfeger currently owns 2.4 percent of the machine tool and industrial products company, Harnischfeger said.
